records.event: Anzu Robotics, Cogito Tech / SPECTA, and SkyRover / Knowact continue to exhibit characteristics of gray zone entities due to their reliance on DJI technology and infrastructure.
records.evidence_basis: Existing PIE flags confirm Anzu Robotics' hardware, firmware, and components align with DJI Mavic 3, including identical PCB layouts, relabeled DJI RC Pro controllers, DJI cryptographic keys, and the presence of SecNeo/BangCle Chinese security framework. Cogito Tech / SPECTA's Specta Air has identical PCBs to DJI Air 3 and uses the same DJI P1 chipset. SkyRover / Knowact's app connects directly to DJI cloud infrastructure, uses identical encryption keys, and allows DJI credential login. All three are flagged for technology licensed from DJI (undisclosed for Cogito/SPECTA and SkyRover/Knowact).
records.impact: Continued classification as gray zone entities impacts their eligibility for government contracts and use by federal agencies, aligning with NDAA §848 enforcement.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence
